Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war. What happened
Trump Says Ukraine Needs New Leader Who Can Deal With Putin. Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war. Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged". In our news wrap Friday, Trump says he struck a deal with Russia for millions of tons of diesel in a bid to lower U.S. energy prices, Katie Zacharia will replace Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary, the Pentagon's plans to livestream an execution has drawn strong reactions, Trump launched a new effort to fire Fed governor Lisa Cook, and NFL legend Mike Ditka died at age 86. President Trump struck a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel Friday, allowing the Kremlin to supply 300,000 tons of diesel to the U.S. and the global marketplace, sparking a feud between him and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. 川普稱烏克蘭需要一位能夠與普丁打交道的新領導人。烏克蘭領導人曾表示，與俄羅斯達成的向美國供應柴油的協議將有助於莫斯科為戰爭提供資金。烏克蘭總統嚴厲批評此舉，稱其為「必須結束而不是延長的戰爭投資」。在周五的新聞報導中，川普表示，他與俄羅斯達成了數百萬噸柴油協議，以降低美國能源價格；凱蒂·扎卡里亞將接替卡羅琳·萊維特擔任白宮新聞秘書；五角大樓直播執行死刑的計劃引起了強烈反應；川普發起了一項新舉措，解僱美聯儲理事麗莎·庫克；美國國家橄欖球聯盟傳奇人物邁克·迪特卡去世，享年 86 歲卡。川普總統週五達成了一項解除對俄羅斯柴油製裁的協議，允許克里姆林宮供應柴油30萬噸柴油運往美國和全球市場，引發了他與烏克蘭總統澤連斯基之間的不和。該協議旨在緩解美國在伊朗持續軍事行動引發的能源價格上漲... 為什麼這很重要
